### Alert
A message that stays in the page next to the content it is about, with optional actions.

Component ID: `alert`

[Component documentation](https://www.expressivecss.com/alert.html.md) · [Repository source](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/master/docs/src/pages/alert.astro) · [Matching tag](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/tree/v0.15.0)

#### Selection and adaptation

Runtime ownership: `css-only`. No dedicated entry in the reviewed Google component inventory.

Example: "Saved" after pressing Save is a snackbar. "You're offline; edits sync later" stays true until the connection returns, so it is an alert above the editor.

#### Material mapping

Relationship: none. Web extension; no dedicated entry was observed in the reviewed current M3 component inventory. Replaces the removed banner.

Upstream: web-extension-inventory-reviewed (2026-10-15); [evidence](https://m3.material.io/components).

Requirements and boundaries: design reference web-extensions-review. The inventory page renders client-side, so this review relies on the 2026-09-13 inventory review. Full visual parity and spoken output unverified.

Support (2026-10-15, `llm.md#alert`): A tonal container with an optional leading icon, a heading and text, an end-aligned actions row, a close button and a critical error-container tone.

Web adaptation: A plain div around authored text and buttons; a changing alert puts role="status" or role="alert" on its text, never on the controls.

Known boundary: The layout, both tones, enlarged-text wrapping and the authored role are checked in a browser; live announcements and spoken output remain unverified.

Full parity remains unassessed. [Capability evidence](../references/capability-roadmap.md#alert).

#### Contract

An `.alert` holds an optional leading icon, then the message: a heading, a `<p>`, or both. It stays until the problem goes away or the user dismisses it. Use a snackbar for brief feedback after an action, and a dialog when the user must decide before going on. CSS only; there is no JavaScript.

#### Syntax

```html
<div class="alert">
  <span class="material-symbols" aria-hidden="true">info</span>
  <p>Your trial ends in 3 days. <a href="/plans">See plans</a></p>
</div>
```

#### Also documented

The Alert section of the [API reference](https://www.expressivecss.com/llm.md) also covers Critical, Actions and close, Announcing changes, Error summary, Tokens.

#### Rules

- `alert-is-not-the-banner-landmark`: role="banner" is the page header landmark, not a message. Remove it: a static alert needs no role, and a changing one puts role="status" or role="alert" on its text.
- `alert-live-region-holds-no-controls`: Put role="status" or role="alert" on the alert's text, not on an alert that holds buttons or links. A live region reads its controls' labels as part of the message.
- `error-summary-form-is-novalidate`: Add novalidate to a form with an .error-summary. Without it the browser stops an invalid submit before the submit event, so the summary never fills and only the first field's bubble shows.
- `error-summary-has-a-list`: Give the .error-summary an empty <ul>. The Forms behavior writes one link per invalid field into it.
